blocks.text:
The recommended daily intake of vitamin C for adults is 2,000 mg. This requirement can be met by eating fruits and vegetables.

However, Vitamin C in fruits and vegetables can be easily lost during storage and cooking because it is water-soluble. As a result, this method may not always provide the amount of vitamin C your body needs.

For this reason, Vitamin C injection has become an alternative way to increase vitamin C levels. This method is considered more effective because it is absorbed more easily than oral supplements. Some sources also state that the body absorbs 100% of injected vitamin C, and the results may be seen more quickly than taking daily vitamin C supplements.
What Are the Benefits of Vitamin C Injection?

Vitamin C injection is one way to increase vitamin C levels in addition to food and oral supplements.

It is administered directly into a vein, muscle, or under the skin.

This procedure is commonly recommended for people with vitamin C deficiency or those recovering from certain infections, as vitamin C helps support the immune system. It is also widely used for skin care treatments.

Some of the potential benefits include:

items: Helping protect the skin from UV exposure
